create_adamax_optimizer: create an Adamax optimizer instance with custom learning rate, betas, and epsilon parameters

review_adamax_weight_decay: review the Adamax optimizer step method to understand the fixed weight decay implementation

summarize_adamax_config: summarize the FairseqAdamax optimizer_config property that returns overridable optimizer arguments
